operations.description: Get latest data for specific country. Country name and format are in parametars.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] latest country data by name [PATH] country [PARAMS] format name [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get latest data from all countries.

operations.description: Get latest data for specific country. Country code and format are in parametars. Country code is in ISO 3166-1 standard. It can be 2 chars (Alpha-2) or 3 chars (Alpha-3) type.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] latest country data by code [PATH] country code [PARAMS] code format [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get name name, alpha-2, alpha-3 code, latitude and longitude for every country.

operations.description: Get daily report for all countries. Date is mandatory parametar. Date format is by ISO 8601 standard, but you can provide different format with date-format parameter.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] daily report all countries [PATH] report country all [PARAMS] date format [SCHEMA]
